title: ononis tridentata var. intermedia
intro: Ononis tridentata var. intermedia, commonly known as Syrian spiny restharrow, is a plant species within the Fabaceae family, characterized by its spiny stems and purple flowers. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, pain, and digestive issues, due to its potential health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Ononis tridentata var. intermedia include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects, which may help alleviate pain, reduce inflammation, and relax muscles. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
